Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

translations.web: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
translations.bsb: And they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door.
translations.kjv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
translations.asv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
